notes.title: The mobile version of Kinetic Anatomy 3D is free !
Update for version 1.90
notes.notes:
1. Added the landmark viewing function. (Now you can view bone landmark in advanced panel for most bones)
2.Added 3 muscle stretching action scenes. More stretching action scenes will be updated in the future!

notes.title: The 1.85 version update adds the loop playback function.
notes.notes: The 1.85 version update adds the loop playback function and allows for custom playback intervals. Based on user feedback, the loop playback (repeat, forward, reverse) function has been added.
